استزرن (form X)
# اِسْتَزَرْنَ (istazarna) /is.ta.zar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
# اُسْتُزِرْنَ (ustuzirna) /us.tu.zir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
# اِسْتَزِرْنَ (istazirna) /is.ta.zir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
